faq.question: Is Kontrora really free to self-host?
faq.answer: Yes. The Community plan is MIT licensed — you can self-host Kontrora for free with no restrictions. You only pay for your own hosting (typically a $5–20/month VPS for small teams).

faq.question: How many users can I have?
faq.answer: All plans support unlimited users. No per-seat charges. Kontrora is built for teams of 5–50, but there's no hard limit.

faq.question: What's included in the Managed plan?
faq.answer: Managed includes hosting, automatic updates, daily backups, uptime monitoring, a custom domain, and priority email support — Kontrora without the DevOps.

faq.question: Can I migrate from self-hosted to Managed?
faq.answer: Yes. We provide migration assistance to move your data from a self-hosted instance to managed infrastructure with zero downtime.

faq.question: What database does Kontrora use?
faq.answer: Kontrora uses Supabase (PostgreSQL) with Row Level Security. Run it locally via Docker or connect to a hosted Supabase project.

faq.question: Do you offer a trial for the Managed plan?
faq.answer: Yes — reach out via /contact and we'll set up a 14-day free trial of the Managed plan.

qa.answer:
Kontrora PSA is an open-source Professional Services Automation platform for agencies and consultancies. It unifies projects, time tracking, capacity planning, workflows, client portal, analytics, and RBAC in one system — so you stop juggling five tabs and a spreadsheet.

Explore features or try the live demo.
Kontrora is built for agencies and consultancies, especially teams of 5–50 who outgrew spreadsheets and multi-tool stacks like Monday.com, Notion, and Slack. There's no hard user limit on any plan.

Community (self-hosted) is free forever under MIT license.

Managed hosting is $39/month billed annually or $49/month monthly — includes hosting, updates, backups, monitoring, custom domain, and priority support.

Enterprise is custom pricing with dedicated infrastructure, SSO/SAML, and onboarding.

All plans include unlimited users. See /pricing.

Yes! Kontrora is open source (MIT license) and free to self-host on your own infrastructure. The Community plan includes all core features and unlimited users. Typical VPS hosting costs $5–20/month for small teams.

The Managed plan is $39/month when billed annually (~20% savings) or $49/month monthly. It includes hosting, automatic updates, daily backups, uptime monitoring, custom domain, and priority email support. A 14-day free trial is available — contact us at /contact.

Enterprise is custom pricing and includes everything in Managed plus dedicated infrastructure, custom SLA, SSO/SAML, a dedicated Slack channel, onboarding & training, and custom feature development. Contact us at /contact.
All Kontrora plans include unlimited users — no per-seat pricing. Kontrora is optimized for teams of 5–50, but there's no hard cap.

Three ways to get started:
1. Start free trial in the cloud app
2. Explore the live demo
3. Self-host the open-source Community edition via GitHub
Explore the live demo anytime — no signup required. For a guided walkthrough, visit /contact and select "Request a demo".
Self-hosting is always free — no trial needed. For the Managed cloud plan, we offer a 14-day free trial. Start a cloud trial at app.kontrora.com or contact us at /contact.

Capacity Planning gives real-time visibility into every team member's availability before you commit to new work — by person, department, or org level. Includes proportional allocation, forecasting, and a leave/holiday calendar. See /features.

Time Tracking includes clock in/out with task allocation, manual retroactive entry, auto clock-out after 16 hours, a 14-day edit window, and full admin team analytics with billable vs non-billable tracking.
Workflow Automation turns your SOPs into visual, enforced workflows with a drag-and-drop builder (8 node types), role assignments, client approvals, automatic handoffs, and a complete audit trail.
Kontrora supports Kanban boards (drag-and-drop), Gantt charts (dependencies + critical path), Table views (bulk updates), and Workflow views — all switchable instantly on the same project.

The Client Portal gives each client a secure, branded window into their projects — real-time visibility, approval workflows, satisfaction scoring, and invite-based access. Internal operations stay hidden via RLS.

Security is built-in: ~40 permissions across 15 categories, custom roles, context-aware project permissions, PostgreSQL Row Level Security on every table, audit logging, rate limiting, and input validation.
Kontrora is built on Next.js 15, TypeScript, Express.js (API on port 4000), Supabase (PostgreSQL + RLS), Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui, Zod, Recharts, and Docker. Requires Node.js 18+.
Kontrora uses Supabase (PostgreSQL) with Row Level Security enforced at the database level. You can run Supabase locally via Docker or connect to a hosted Supabase project.

Deploy Kontrora via Docker Compose on any Linux VPS, cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure, DigitalOcean, Hetzner), or on-premise hardware. Configure Supabase, run the Express API (port 4000) and Next.js frontend (port 3000), then complete onboarding. Source code: GitHub.
Yes — Kontrora is fully open source under the MIT license. View, fork, and modify the code on GitHub. No vendor lock-in.
Reach us at support@kontrora.com, call +1 (929) 612 9360, or visit /contact. Office: 888 Broadway, Floor 4, New York, NY 10003. We typically respond within 1 business day.

Kontrora was built inside a student-run marketing agency managing 11 clients across 8 departments. The team was tired of juggling Basecamp, Monday.com, Notion, MS Planner, and Slack — so they built one platform to answer "Do we have capacity for this?" in seconds. Learn more at /about.

v1.0 (released): projects, time, capacity, workflows, RBAC, client portal.

Q1–Q2 2026 (in progress): analytics, project health scoring, client dashboard enhancements.

Q3–Q4 2026 (planned): revenue tools, proposals, CRM, QuickBooks/Stripe integration.

See the full timeline at /roadmap.

We're hiring! 9 open remote-first roles including Full-Stack Engineer, Frontend Engineer, Product Designer, Web3 Engineer, and QA Engineer. All roles are async-friendly. Apply at /careers — we review within 5 business days.
Report bugs by emailing support@kontrora.com or opening an issue on GitHub.
Yes — we provide migration assistance to move from a self-hosted instance to Managed hosting with zero downtime. Contact us at /contact.

Kontrora includes:
• Capacity Planning — real-time availability
• Time Tracking — clock in/out + analytics
• Workflow Automation — visual SOPs with audit trail
• Task Management — Kanban, Gantt, Table, Workflow views
